title: 中国人民银行副行长陈德霖：互联互通扩容，外资储备加码香港
speaker: Chen Derling

segments.en: PBOC will work closer to the SAO government and other authorities to work in four regards and consolidate Hong Kong's strength in finance and open up more areas of development. Connection scheme will help the development of the financial market.
segments.zh: 人民银行将与香港金管局等部门密切合作，从四方面巩固香港金融优势，拓展发展空间。互联互通将助力金融市场发展。

segments.en: Financial market is the essential part of Hong Kong's hub, Hong Kong's hub row as the financial market and a lot of the companies joining this market from the mainland in Hong Kong will support the high-quality enterprises to get listed in Hong Kong and explore more connections scheme, on bond, interest, swap and wealth management. And we will also integrate the financial management system of the Great Bay Area.
segments.zh: 金融市场是香港枢纽的核心，大量内地企业来港上市，支持优质企业上市并拓展债券、利率互换、理财等互联互通。还将整合大湾区金融管理体系。

segments.en: Source and bond size of the bond connect scheme will be enlarged from 500 billion to 800 billion and source bond will be included in the buy-byte supportive scheme and the coverage will include the RMB and Hong Kong dollar related products. Also, Markle Market will be included.
segments.zh: 债券通南向通额度从5000亿增至8000亿，并纳入人民币和港币相关产品，货币市场也将纳入。

segments.en: Last year, I mentioned that the foreign reserve of the PBOC will have more presence in Hong Kong. In the past one year, the foreign reserve is active in investing in Hong Kong. In the future, the foreign reserve will have more allocation in the Hong Kong market that will give a vitality to the Hong Kong's development.
segments.zh: 去年我提到外汇储备将更多配置香港。过去一年已积极投资，未来将加大配置，为香港发展注入活力。
